newsitem.title: CANADA: Onex says plans C$176 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Onex says plans C$176 mln share issue.

text.p: Onex Corp said on Monday that it has agreed to sell 7.65 million subordinate voting shares at a price of C$23 per share for total proceeds of C$176 million.

"Onex is continuing its growth and the additional funds from this offering will allow us to consider new acquisition opportunities," Onex president and chief executive officer Gerald Schwartz said in a statement.
Onex said it has granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to acquire up to an additional 1.05 million shares at the same offer price.
Following the offering, Onex said it will have about 48.7 million subordinate voting shares outstanding.
Onex said the offering is expected to be completed by January 31. The underwriting syndicate is led by Newcrest Capital Inc.
